scope: Original Nemesis basic-board standard semi-cooperative core, six original characters. Original English 28-page manual (including illustrations), official FAQ v2.2 base-game Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items, compatible supplemental wording in original publisher-hosted localizations. Optional modes, boards, campaigns and expansions excluded.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks card refill, token passing, deck exhaustion and discard destinations. Neither request nor key supplies repeated clockwise rounds or the all-passed gate.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: A Character in a burning Room takes one Action then passes. When do they take Fire damage, can they act again this Player Phase, can they discard cards, and do later players rounds burn them again?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: At end of own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars normal Actions this Player Phase, but official FAQ permits Interruption after passing. May discard any number of hand cards on passing. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks one Character taking an Action then passing, Fire damage, further Actions and discards. Explains individual pass consequences but not how all players rounds repeat or terminate the phase.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: After two Actions your hand is empty. Do you automatically pass then, and what timing consequence can Fire or Bleeding have?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No automatic pass. Wait for next round to pass; can suffer Fire/Bleeding again because passing ends another round.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Assumes a two-Action round and asks when an empty-hand player passes. Its next-round timing does not ask who next acts or what collective condition starts Event Phase.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Give the Event Phase order, which Intruders move on an Event card, what controls movement and when the event effect resolves; what happens when Event and Intruder Attack decks run out?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Time and active Self-Destruct advance, Intruders in Combat attack, Fire Damage, Event card movement then effect, bag development fully resolved before next turn. Move symbol-matching Intruders without Characters in Room via card-number Corridor; ducts remove miniature/return token. Discard Event unless instructed otherwise. Empty Event/Attack decks reshuffle their respective discard piles.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Event Phase order, movement and deck exhaustion once that phase exists. It does not ask when Player Phase transitions into it.

accepted_additions.novelty: No existing actual stem asks the collective repeated clockwise two-Action scheduling loop or all-players-passed transition gate. Q04/Q91 cover individual passing consequences, Q23 draw/token/discards, Q24 Event steps. This adds actual phase control, not another pass example.

accepted_additions.topic: Canteen/Shower principal benefit plus optional additional scan, not OR

raw_source_references.location: Canteen and Shower Room: principal benefit followed by Additionally, you may choose to Scan all Contamination cards in your hand

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Contrast Canteen/Shower scanning with Surgery: which cards are scanned and removed, how is a Larva handled, and what costs or turn consequences follow Surgery?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Stem is expressly a scanning-versus-Surgery comparison: scopes/removal, Larva and Surgery costs/turn consequences. Key volunteers Canteen healing and Shower Slime removal, but neither those benefits nor their optional additive relationship to scanning is actually requested.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Defines Heal and injury/death thresholds; does not ask these Rooms effects or whether scanning replaces them.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatment choices. Applying its OR structure to Canteen/Shower would give a wrong outcome; these Rooms provide their principal benefit AND an optional scan.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Does entering Room Covered With Slime require an Action to acquire Slime, can it have an Item Counter or Malfunction, can Slime stack, and does showering extinguish Fire?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Entry automatically gives Slime; no paid Action. No Item Counter, never Malfunction. Max one Slime, extra does nothing; Clothes/Shower remove. Shower does not remove Fire and Fire allowed there. On first entering the Room Covered With Slime, acquire Slime before resolving its Exploration token. Thus a Silence Exploration effect becomes Danger on that first entry, subject to the already-covered Careful Movement/Reconnaissance cancellation.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Slime acquisition, counters/markers/stacking and whether Shower extinguishes Fire. Its key volunteers Shower removal, but stem does not request what Shower removes or whether scanning is additional.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Outside Combat, what can a single use of Bandages do to Wounds, and what two alternatives does Clothes offer? Can Bandages heal an undressed Serious Wound directly? Give each Item's Action-card cost and whether its alternatives can be combined in one use.
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Bandages costs 1 Action card and either dresses 1 Serious Wound OR heals all Light Wounds. It does not directly heal/discard an undressed Serious Wound. Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.
closest_old_requests.novelty_comparison: Asks Clothes/Bandages OR menus. Does not ask the additive optional scanning relationship in these Room Actions.

accepted_additions.novelty: Accept only the new coupling/optionality request: one paid Room Action gives its principal benefit AND may additionally scan, and scan may be declined without forfeiting that benefit. Q17 asks scan/Surgery scopes, removal, Larva and Surgery consequences; its volunteered treatment context is not asked. Q45 asks entry/markers/stack/Fire; Q36/Q112 ask mutually exclusive OR treatments. This explicit additive-versus-replacement outcome is distinct from merely renaming a healing carrier or changing its dose. Pair both Rooms in one question.

accepted_additions.topic: Contamination hidden-status and exact Scanner classification
accepted_additions.novelty: A player can know all existing scope/removal/Larva/final-check answers while treating face-up patterned infection as known information or accepting a near-match coded word. Q127 tests the source-defined transition from hidden to classified infection information. It adds neither another scan carrier nor a changed cost/dose, and does not duplicate a fact actually asked but missing from a key.

raw_source_references.location: right column Contamination cards, hidden-information paragraph
raw_source_references.primary_passage: Each Contamination card contains hidden information: the Character may be INFECTED or not. This information is hidden by colorful patterns in the text field. Unless the card is “Scanned”, this information remains unknown to the player until the end of the game.

raw_source_references.location: upper-left column, continuation of Scanning and removing Contamination cards
raw_source_references.primary_passage: Take the Scanner and place its red foil part over the coded field of the Contamination card you’re Scanning. In one of the lines of text, the word INFECTED may appear. If not, the card is NOT INFECTED. Note: Look closely at the cards, because some of the coded words may be seemingly similar to INFECTED.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Contrast Canteen/Shower scanning with Surgery: which cards are scanned and removed, how is a Larva handled, and what costs or turn consequences follow Surgery?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Give the endgame checks in order. What happens with two Damaged Engines, a non-Earth destination (including Quarantine/Mars), and an infected survivor or one carrying a Larva? Do pod passengers need Contamination checks?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Engines then Coordinates then Contamination then Objectives. If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. All survivors including launched pod passengers scan all Contamination; any infected triggers shuffle all Action/Contamination draw 4, any Contamination kills else survives. Larva skips scanning and directly does shuffle/draw. Survivors then reveal/check chosen Objective.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: At the final Contamination check, a survivor has no Larva and every Contamination card scans non-Infected. Must they perform the four-card draw or remove those cards, and does an earlier launched Pod escape the Objective check?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No four-card draw unless infected found or Larva on board; end scan does not instruct removing non-infected. Pod passenger still needs surviving Contamination check and chosen Objective fulfillment.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Rest scans several Infected cards while no Larva was on your board. Can the scan kill you from multiple infected cards; when can Rest be fatal?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No; place one Larva regardless number infected. Can be fatal only if a Larva already was on board before Rest.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Alcohol scans an Infected Contamination card. Does this place a Larva and what happens instead?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No Larva from this result; take a new Contamination card.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Describe Antidote: scan scope, removed cards, new Contamination, reshuffling, hand retention and passing; how does Surgery differ?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Scan all Contamination from hand/deck/discard, remove all Infected from game, take one new Contamination, reshuffle it with all non-Infected scanned Contamination and Action cards except cards left in hand, then pass. May retain hand cards. Surgery instead shuffles entire hand too and does not gain extra Contamination (and its own wound/removal procedure still applies). Antidote also removes a Larva already on the Character board.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: When you use Canteen or Shower, what non-scanning benefit does each Room give? Must you choose between that benefit and scanning Contamination, or can one Room Action give both? May you take the non-scanning benefit without choosing to scan?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Canteen heals 1 Light Wound. Shower discards your Slime marker if you have one. Each additionally permits you to choose to scan all Contamination cards in your hand and remove all non-Infected cards; that scan is optional and additional to the Room benefit, not an OR replacement. You may take the non-scanning benefit without scanning. If you do scan, resolve the infected/Larva consequences as normal. Pay the ordinary single Room Action cost, subject to common Room restrictions.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: You roll a number for a Corridor already holding Noise, with a Technical Corridors Entrance in your Room. Give the Encounter sequence, Noise removal, token destination and Surprise Attack comparison; do Contamination cards count?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Resolve Encounter: remove all connected Noise including Technical Corridors; draw bag token; place matching Intruder; compare token number to all cards in triggering hand including Contamination. Fewer cards causes Surprise Attack against triggerer, equal or more does not. Set token aside.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: In an ordinary Intruder Attack with several Characters, how is the target chosen and ties broken; how is a hit determined; what changes for Larva and where does its Contamination go?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Fewest Action cards in hand; tie First Player or next in turn order. Matching attacker symbol on drawn Attack card means resolve effect; otherwise miss; ignore blood and discard card. Larva draws no Attack card: place miniature on target Character board and give Contamination on top of Action discard.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Which Items may be hidden, what do other players see, what is the Inventory limit, and what must happen on use? How are Heavy Items/Objects, added Items and Duct Tape handled?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Normal Items hidden in unlimited Inventory, others see backs/colors; used Item shown. Heavy Items/Objects public in two Hands, third requires dropping one. Added Items act as one with base card. Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one Hand, never Objects.

accepted_additions.topic: Escape Pod launch component removal and end of active participation
accepted_additions.novelty: Distinct source-defined launch resolution/player-participation outcome; first/second occupant variation is not its novelty basis.

raw_source_references.location: Escape Pods, after entering and launching now or in later turns

closest_old_requests.actual_request: What permits or prevents entering an Escape Pod, what must you resolve first, how many Characters and Heavy Objects fit, and what are the options and consequences when you wait?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Use corresponding Evacuation Room Action cost 2, unlocked Pod with free space, no Intruder/Malfunction. Roll Noise first and fail if Intruder reaches Room. Two Character spaces; Heavy Objects use none. Enter then launch immediately or wait and pass current turn. At start of first round next Player Phase choose wait/pass, launch, or free exit followed by a full two-Action round. Intruder appearing in Section returns all Pod occupants; another boarder may immediately launch.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Accepted Q19 scope requires launch as a waiting option, not complete launch resolution.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: Give the endgame checks in order. What happens with two Damaged Engines, a non-Earth destination (including Quarantine/Mars), and an infected survivor or one carrying a Larva? Do pod passengers need Contamination checks?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Engines then Coordinates then Contamination then Objectives. If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. All survivors including launched pod passengers scan all Contamination; any infected triggers shuffle all Action/Contamination draw 4, any Contamination kills else survives. Larva skips scanning and directly does shuffle/draw. Survivors then reveal/check chosen Objective.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks endgame status/checks or waiting contingencies; does not ask launch component removal and ending active participation.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: At the final Contamination check, a survivor has no Larva and every Contamination card scans non-Infected. Must they perform the four-card draw or remove those cards, and does an earlier launched Pod escape the Objective check?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: No four-card draw unless infected found or Larva on board; end scan does not instruct removing non-infected. Pod passenger still needs surviving Contamination check and chosen Objective fulfillment.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks endgame status/checks or waiting contingencies; does not ask launch component removal and ending active participation.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: For a rule concerned with the Character's arrival on Earth, where is a Character in a launched Escape Pod treated as having arrived? Does this establish that the ship itself reached Earth?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Any Character in a launched Escape Pod is always treated as having arrived on Earth. This is the Character's status and does not establish that the ship reached Earth; the ship's destination and survival are checked separately. The passenger still undergoes the normal endgame Contamination and Objective checks.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks endgame status/checks or waiting contingencies; does not ask launch component removal and ending active participation.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: While waiting in an Escape Pod, must you roll Noise when Adult bag development calls for it?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: Yes. Waiting Character is treated as present in the corresponding Room and rolls Noise.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks endgame status/checks or waiting contingencies; does not ask launch component removal and ending active participation.

closest_old_requests.actual_request: A Malfunction is placed in the Evacuation Section while you are already waiting in its Pod. Can you launch, wait or exit, and what does that Malfunction prevent?
closest_old_requests.actual_key: May still launch, wait or exit; Malfunction only prevents using Room Action to ENTER Pods.
closest_old_requests.why_not_covering_new_fact: Asks endgame status/checks or waiting contingencies; does not ask launch component removal and ending active participation.
